# Nebius Token Factory documentation

> Comprehensive Nebius Token Factory documentation: quickstart, API reference, model inference guides, fine-tuning, integrations & examples for seamless LLM deployment.

- [ Dataset formats for fine-tuning](https://docs.tokenfactory.nebius.com/post-training/datasets.md)
- [Models for fine-tuning in Nebius Token Factory](https://docs.tokenfactory.nebius.com/post-training/models.md): Supported base models for fine-tuning in Nebius Token Factory, with available context lengths and fine-tuning types (LoRA and full fine-tuning), grouped by provider.
- [Supervised Finetuning ](https://docs.tokenfactory.nebius.com/post-training/how-to-fine-tune.md): Fine-tune a base model on your own data using Nebius Token Factory. This guide walks you through creating a job, monitoring it, and retrieving checkpoints via API and Python.
- [Custom speculator](https://docs.tokenfactory.nebius.com/post-training/custom-speculator.md)
- [Merging LoRA Adapters](https://docs.tokenfactory.nebius.com/post-training/merge-moe-lora-weights.md): When you fine-tune a model with LoRA, inference usually requires loading both the base model and the LoRA adapter. Here we provide a merge script that bakes the LoRA adapters directly into the base weights and produces a standard checkpoint directory.

- [Import Chat Completions](https://docs.tokenfactory.nebius.com/data-lab/chat-completions.md)
- [Fine-tuning](https://docs.tokenfactory.nebius.com/data-lab/fine-tuning.md)
- [Data Processing](https://docs.tokenfactory.nebius.com/data-lab/data-processing.md)
- [Datasets](https://docs.tokenfactory.nebius.com/data-lab/datasets.md)
- [Sandboxes overview](https://docs.tokenfactory.nebius.com/sandboxes/overview.md): Give applications and AI agents an isolated environment to execute code, evaluate results, and work with files.
- [Set up access](https://docs.tokenfactory.nebius.com/sandboxes/start/set-up-access.md): Create credentials, select a project, verify Sandboxes access, and find a base image.
- [Python quickstart](https://docs.tokenfactory.nebius.com/sandboxes/start/python-quickstart.md): Create a Python project, save a filesystem change, and reuse it in a later operation.
- [CLI quickstart](https://docs.tokenfactory.nebius.com/sandboxes/start/cli-quickstart.md): Install the Sandboxes CLI, configure a profile, and reuse saved filesystem state.
- [Choose an interface](https://docs.tokenfactory.nebius.com/sandboxes/start/choose-an-interface.md): Choose between the Python SDK, REST API, CLI, and MCP for a Sandboxes workflow.
- [Execution lifecycle](https://docs.tokenfactory.nebius.com/sandboxes/concepts/execution-lifecycle.md): Understand operations, processes, client waits, event streams, and saved images.
- [Images, checkpoints, and branches](https://docs.tokenfactory.nebius.com/sandboxes/concepts/images-checkpoints-and-branches.md): Save filesystem state deliberately and start independent work from immutable images.
- [Sessions and execution modes](https://docs.tokenfactory.nebius.com/sandboxes/concepts/sessions-and-execution-modes.md): Distinguish client workflow state from operations and live processes.
- [Run commands and handle results](https://docs.tokenfactory.nebius.com/sandboxes/guides/run-commands-and-results.md): Choose command or shell execution, make persistence explicit, and interpret operation and process results.
- [Stream output and events](https://docs.tokenfactory.nebius.com/sandboxes/guides/stream-output-and-events.md): Observe stdout, stderr, and operation events over SSE, resume after disconnect, and verify the final result.
- [Run subprocesses and send input](https://docs.tokenfactory.nebius.com/sandboxes/guides/run-subprocesses-and-send-input.md): Start an additional process inside an active operation, exchange input, observe output, and end it deliberately.
- [Prepare and reuse environments](https://docs.tokenfactory.nebius.com/sandboxes/guides/prepare-and-reuse-environments.md): Create a reusable filesystem image from setup commands, OCI import, or the supported CLI Dockerfile workflow.
- [Work with files and artifacts](https://docs.tokenfactory.nebius.com/sandboxes/guides/work-with-files-and-artifacts.md): Inject files, retain generated artifacts, inspect images, and download bytes after execution.
- [Branch, compare, and recover](https://docs.tokenfactory.nebius.com/sandboxes/guides/branch-compare-and-recover.md): Run alternatives from one image, select a verified result, and recover from a known-good checkpoint.
- [Configure networking and secrets](https://docs.tokenfactory.nebius.com/sandboxes/guides/configure-networking-and-secrets.md): Disable the guest network where supported and keep credentials out of retained state and output.
- [Run concurrent workloads](https://docs.tokenfactory.nebius.com/sandboxes/guides/run-concurrent-workloads.md): Bound parallel operations, correlate state, classify failures, and cancel only work owned by the batch.
- [Sandboxes cookbook](https://docs.tokenfactory.nebius.com/sandboxes/cookbook/index.md): Complete Sandboxes workflows with explicit state, expected outcomes, and failure handling.
- [Prepare once, reuse safely](https://docs.tokenfactory.nebius.com/sandboxes/cookbook/prepare-once-reuse-safely.md): Save one prepared filesystem image and reuse it in independent later operations.
- [Stream a build or test run](https://docs.tokenfactory.nebius.com/sandboxes/cookbook/stream-a-build-or-test-run.md): Run a deterministic test suite, display stdout and stderr over SSE, resume after disconnect, and verify both success and failure.
- [Interact with a process during an operation](https://docs.tokenfactory.nebius.com/sandboxes/cookbook/interact-with-a-process.md): Spawn a child in an active operation, send two inputs and EOF, test signals and parent finalization, and clean up on failure.
- [Try two coding fixes and keep the passing branch](https://docs.tokenfactory.nebius.com/sandboxes/cookbook/try-two-coding-fixes.md): Apply two isolated patches to failing deterministic tests, select the passing image, and continue from it.
- [Generate and download a binary artifact](https://docs.tokenfactory.nebius.com/sandboxes/cookbook/generate-and-download-binary-artifact.md): Produce a deterministic binary file, retain it, download it, and verify exact bytes locally.
- [Build and refresh a reusable custom environment](https://docs.tokenfactory.nebius.com/sandboxes/cookbook/build-reusable-custom-environment.md): Build the supported Dockerfile subset, resolve the immutable UUID, run twice, and refresh after a source change.
- [Prepare inputs, then verify with networking disabled](https://docs.tokenfactory.nebius.com/sandboxes/cookbook/verify-with-networking-disabled.md): Save prepared inputs, verify them without a guest network interface, and inspect both operations using Python.
- [Run a bounded evaluation batch](https://docs.tokenfactory.nebius.com/sandboxes/cookbook/run-bounded-evaluation-batch.md): Correlate item, operation, and image IDs; classify outcomes; and cancel only work owned by the batch.
- [Recover from a known-good image](https://docs.tokenfactory.nebius.com/sandboxes/cookbook/recover-from-known-good-image.md): Diagnose a deliberate command failure and retry corrected work from the recorded checkpoint.
- [Troubleshooting](https://docs.tokenfactory.nebius.com/sandboxes/operate/troubleshooting.md): Diagnose access, execution, output, state, subprocess, network, and concurrency failures.
- [Limits, retention, and usage](https://docs.tokenfactory.nebius.com/sandboxes/operate/limits-retention-and-usage.md): Plan for service limits and retention, and inspect the fields available to your account.
- [Security and data handling](https://docs.tokenfactory.nebius.com/sandboxes/operate/security-and-data-handling.md): Protect data and credentials across uploads, output, images, networking, and local downloads.
- [Update images and clients](https://docs.tokenfactory.nebius.com/sandboxes/operate/update-images-and-clients.md): Refresh prepared images, pin immutable inputs, and validate client upgrades.
- [Reference map and compatibility](https://docs.tokenfactory.nebius.com/sandboxes/reference/index.md): Find REST endpoints, Python methods, CLI commands, and MCP tools for your workflow.
